intro: Mauritius is a parliamentary democracy, often ranked Africa's most democratic country.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government; the president is ceremonial. Navin Ramgoolam returned as prime minister after a landslide win in 2024.

chapters.title: Chagos
text: Mauritius won a long campaign for the return of the Chagos Islands.

keyTerms.meaning: Voters elect a parliament that chooses the government.

cardGroups.intro: Who chooses whom, and what each part of the system does.
